The void was made more distinct, more real as the worlds came into being. A great contrast of, for a lack of better analogies, light and dark, music and silence. A fascinating phenomenon, the spread of "existence", if uncontained, could threaten the void itself. A corruption spreads from these planes and worlds, pervading the void around it.

The objective of Project: Purity was simple, isolate the void from this new "existence". Contain this "corruption" until the time is right for the "corruption" to be removed. Each plane, like a marble, even if there were no dimensions to describe them in.

As the work was completed, Andromeda gazed with some satisfaction. Sometimes the void must yield, the infancy of an universe was one such time. With this yielding was a promise, a promise to reclaim that which has been lost.
